text: Marcus, can you get the make-ready on 3B done before Thursday? Tomasz has a showing lined up for Friday morning and I don't want him walking a dirty unit again.
Hollis Court boiler is still short on pressure in the basement. Gil says the replacement unit ships the 14th but the lien waiver from the plumber is still missing so I can't release the next draw.
Thanks Bev, that was a great catch on the 4C lease renewal. I owe you lunch, Pad Thai place on Main?
Work order 2231 for the Linden Row kitchen faucet got closed without a photo. Can someone reopen it and get the before and after pics uploaded to Buildium today please.
Priya, the T12 for Ashford Lofts is off by about $4,100 on the CAM line. I think the janitorial invoice from March got posted twice. Can you pull the GL detail and confirm?
Quick question, does the Pine Street roof recoat RFP need the COI from the bonding company or can we accept the broker letter for now.
Hi Mr. Okafor, just confirming the plumber will be in your unit Tuesday between 9 and noon to look at the slow drain. Please keep the hallway clear for access.
Renee, owner draw for October is ready to go out. Vacancy loss is up because Linden Row has three dead units right now, two of them in turn. Full packet attached.
Gil, the elevator inspector cancelled again. Can you call the Ashford Lofts modernization contractor and ask for their updated punch list before the Friday walk?
Tenants in Building B, the water will be shut off from 8 to 11 Wednesday for the riser repair. Please fill any containers you need the night before. Sorry for the short notice.
NTV came in from unit 2D, effective date is Jan 31. Put it in the rent roll and flag the unit for pre-lease photos before we list it.
Dana, the delinquency report has eleven households over 30 days. Four already have payment plans, the rest need a 3-day notice drafted. Can you review before I send anything out?
Ok I'm walking the Pine Street units with Marcus at 2 if anyone wants to come. Bring the spec sheet for the new shingles, the roofer is asking about color.
Thank you so much for being patient with the parking situation this week. We're getting the striping redone on the lot next Monday and I'll post the new assigned spots by Friday.
Marcus, the boiler vendor wants a PO number before they'll schedule the Hollis Court install. Can you get that from Renee and send it over? Priority one on this.
Tomasz, got your renewal offer list. Two units need a concession because the market rent dropped on Ashford. Let's talk about the numbers at 10 tomorrow.
Linden Row 5A is move-out clean, carpets pulled, paint touch-up tomorrow. Punch list is four items and none of them block the listing. Rent it at 1,725 starting the 1st.
Bev says the resident in 6F wants a call back about the noise complaint. Can you handle it when you get a chance? She's been very patient with us.
Need the lien waiver from Carrero Mechanical before we release the retention on the Pine Street job. Their accountant is out this week so ask for Lou in the office.
Hey, did the dumpster pickup happen at Hollis Court this morning? The enclosure gate was still open at noon and the cans are overflowing.
Schedule of values for the Ashford Lofts elevator job came in higher than the bid. Gil, can you ask them to break out the cab interior and the controller separately so we can compare?
Thanks everyone for the quick turnaround on the Linden Row walk. Marcus, your crew cut the make-ready time almost in half. Let's keep that pace through the holidays.
Renee wants the Hollis Court capital reserve balance by Thursday. Priya, can you reconcile the bank statement against the boiler draw and send me the running total?
The 4C tenant emailed asking about the balcony door seal. Log it as a work order under Linden Row and put it on Marcus's list for the next walk, low priority.
Coffee run at 9 at the Dunkin on Route 9 if anyone needs anything. I'm buying, no excuses. Also reminder the unit walk schedule is posted in the shared drive.
Okay so the boiler vendor says the pressure relief valve is the real problem, not the expansion tank. Can we pull a permit before they cut into the mechanical room wall?
Bev, can you do a welcome call for the new tenant moving into 3A on the 15th? Lease is signed and the deposit cleared. Keys go to the leasing office at 3pm.
Pine Street roof is leaking into 4B again after the storm. Marcus put a bucket under it for now. We need a temporary patch and a roofer out here before the next forecast.
Not a big deal but the lobby light outside Hollis Court Building A is flickering. Maybe a ballast. Put it on the list for Gil's electrician, no rush.
Priya, can you send the rent roll for the Ashford portfolio with the new renewals marked? Owner meeting is Monday and Renee wants the vacancy numbers broken out by building.
Concession on 2D was approved for one month free on a 14-month lease. Tomasz, please update the renewal offer and send the revised lease addendum before end of day.
The elevator modernization permit finally cleared the city. Gil, tell the contractor they can mobilize Monday, but they need the COI on file first or we don't let them in the building.
Morning all. Reminder that the fire panel test at Linden Row is Wednesday at 10. Residents on floors 3 through 5 need notice by Monday, please post in the lobby and send the email blast.
Hi Ms. Lindqvist, sorry for the delay on your deposit return. It went out today by check, should reach you in about five business days. Let me know if it doesn't show up.
Dana, can you look at the T12 variance for Linden Row? Water is up 18 percent and I want to know if it's the new irrigation or a leak in the basement.
Turnover on 1C started yesterday. Paint is done, the flooring guy comes Thursday, and the appliances are backordered until the 22nd. Pre-lease photos go up Friday if we're on track.
Need the lien waiver from Carrero again for the Hollis Court boiler, the draw can't go out without it. I already emailed the office twice. Can you call them instead?
Is anyone covering the Ashford Lofts walk tomorrow? Gil is out and the contractor wants a sign-off on the cab finishes before they order the panels.
Thanks for the help with the inspection, Marcus. The city inspector said the boiler room looks clean and the signage is fine. We got a passing certificate on the first try.
Tomasz, the applicant on 5B has a cosigner and the income checks out. Run the screening and send me the report but hold the lease until Renee signs off on the exception.
Good news, the Pine Street roofer can start Monday. The reserve draw is approved, so Priya can release the first payment once their COI and lien waiver come in.
Ok so the NTV for 6F came in and it's effective the 31st. Bev, can you let the resident know the walk-through is set for the 28th at 10? Keep it friendly.
Mr. Adeyemi called about the thermostat in 2B reading wrong. It's probably the battery. Marcus, swap it on the next visit and log it so we have a record if he comes back.
Renee, the Linden Row loss-to-lease report shows $6,200 in gap over the last quarter. Most of it is from the two units that were hanging on old rents. I'd like to push renewals earlier.
Heads up that the water shutoff in Building B got pushed to Thursday. The riser contractor needs the additional day. I'll send another notice tonight so nobody gets caught off guard.
Thanks Priya, the GL is clean now. The duplicate janitorial entry is reversed and the CAM reconciliation for Ashford is ready to go. Send the owner package when you have a minute.
Quick one, did anybody get the key box code changed for the Pine Street gate? The vendor keeps saying it doesn't work and I want to rule out that it's the old code.
Gil, the elevator contractor just sent the revised punch list. Twelve items, nine are cosmetic. Can you confirm the two safety items are done before we sign off on the final payment.
The dog bite incident at Hollis Court needs a written report for our insurance carrier by Friday. Bev, can you collect the statement from the resident and attach the photos?
Long day but the Linden Row turnover count is down to three. Dana, thanks for taking the rent roll update tonight. Tomorrow we get to the flooring on 4D and the cabinets on 1A.
Hey, is the boiler vendor coming back out Tuesday or is that moved? I need to tell Renee whether the reserve draw goes out this week or waits until the inspection report.
Please keep your vehicles out of the fire lane behind the Ashford Lofts dumpster enclosure. The tow company is coming through Friday and we're not paying for the Thursday mistake again.
Marcus, the ice melt order came in short, only four bags out of ten. Call the supplier and get the rest before the next cold snap. The walkways at Pine Street are a liability right now.
Tomasz, the new lease addendum for the pet policy needs both signatures. Can you resend to the Okafor household and the Ruiz unit? Use the new template, not the old one from last year.
I'm out Thursday afternoon for the dentist, so Dana has the on-call phone. Anything with water or power goes to Marcus first, anything with money goes to Priya, the rest can wait for me.

Monthly delinquency check is done. Nine households are current now after payment plans, two moved to notice, and one is in the eviction process. Dana, please double-check the notice dates before anything goes out.
The Hollis Court boiler finally passed the pressure test, and the vendor wants to finish the insulation Monday. Let's get the lien waiver and the final invoice before we release the last draw.
Reminder that the Pine Street walk is moved to Friday at 8 because of the roofer. Bring boots, the gravel bed by the north gutter is still a mess from the storm.

Thanks everyone for the patience this month. Owner meeting went well, Renee wants to keep the same reserve plan for next year and add the Linden Row roof to the list. We will figure out the timing next week.

Last one for today. Can someone check that the 2A and 2B locks were rekeyed after the move-outs? Tomasz says he handed over the keys but the office log is blank, so I want to confirm before the new move-in.
